content.description:
Oniverse is a Play To Earn built on the Cardano network.

Obtain a mining destination through one of our limited NFTs and generate profits while you or other users play on it. Explore your planet for Onanite, send it through the trading platform and you will get ONIM, a fully tradable token with real value.

Aren't you a gamer? Host your planet and allow other players to mine the ore for you while you generate passive income.
